info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Business Reviews Submission API
info.description: The Business Reviews Submission API facilitates the collection and submission of reviews related to market analysis in the banking sector. This endpoint allows businesses to share their insights and feedback based on market research findings. Typical consumers of this API include banking analysts, market researchers, and business intelligence teams looking to enhance their reports with qualitative data. By aggregating reviews, the API aims to improve decision-making and strategy formulation within the banking industry.

post.description: This endpoint allows users to submit a review for a specific market analysis identified by the resource ID RES-100045. Users can provide feedback that contributes to the evaluation of the market analysis.
